content: In this paper, we presented an approach to performing crowd annotation learning based on the idea of adversarial training for Chinese Named Entity Recognition (NER). In our approach, we use a common and private Bi-LSTMs for representing annotator-generic and -specific information, and learn a label Bi-LSTM from the crowd-annotated NE label sequences. Finally, the proposed approach adopts a LSTM-CRF model to perform tagging. In our experiments, we create two data sets for Chinese NER tasks in the dialog and e-commerce domains. The experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms strong baseline systems.
